parts:
Hi,

I have two data frames : one with depths every 5cm, and one every 20 cm (this one have a range 0 to 20- in two separate columns). I want to merge the two based on the range 
so the measurements of 5, 10,15, 20 will have in the new column 20. gets complicated as the measurements go to 14m depth in 20 locations
attached are the two df
any suggestions?

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: merge two data frames based on a range
parts:
Hanna, 

From my perspective, it's not clear what you want out at the end nor what you want to join on. 
Your Hannah_output_rebeka file has 3 depth columns, `depth cm`, depth1 and depth2
Your khThomas file has one depth column. 

You say you want to join, but in order to join you really need to standardize your depths becuase all of the columns are decimals. I think that's what you're saying, but it's not clear how you want to round up or down. 

So which column do you want to join from the HOR file to the thK file? 

How do you want to standardize across files? 

B

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: merge two data frames based on a range
parts:
Hanna,

I haven't fully validated this, but this looks like what you could do to get to a solution:
https://www.mango-solutions.com/blog/in-between-a-rock-and-a-conditional-join

library(fuzzyjoin) # devtools::install_github("dgrtwo/fuzzyjoin")
library(tidyverse)

hor <- read_csv("~/Downloads/hanna_output_rebeka.csv")
kht <- read_csv("~/Downloads/khThomas.csv")


fuzzy_left_join(
kht,
hor,
by=c("depth"="depth1", "depth"="depth2"),
match_fun=list(`>=`, `<=`)
)

That said, the return is way too large. Something like 68k rows. I think you need to join by something else to keep it tight. It looks like mw might be that extra column, but mw is a character in kht and an integer in hor.
Seems closer to a solution, but still some work to do and perhaps some more information from you. Unless you've solved it already?

HTH,
B
